name: ecom Pad-Ex 01
summary: The ecom Pad-Ex 01 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 11.6-inch Windows tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Windows 10 Pro. It has been discontinued; the ecom Pad-Ex 01 P12 DZ2 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T135°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current (family certificate), checked 2026-10-25. Product discontinued.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / Ex ic IIIB T135°C Dc IP64

certification.northAmerica: SGS: Class I, II, III, Division 2, Groups A-G, T4, 135°C; Class I, Zone 2, Group IIC, T4; Ta −10 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: Battery pack removed, changed or charged only outside hazardous areas; reduced-height impact test; protect from high-energy impacts, UV and static; external connections never used in hazardous areas.

specs.display: 11.6-inch Optically bonded sunlight-readable LCD, capacitive multitouch
specs.chip: Intel Core i7-8550U (8th gen) 1.8 GHz, turbo 4.0 GHz
specs.ports: 2 x USB 3.0 Type A; headphone/mic jack; docking connector; microSD; SIM slot
specs.keys: Power, volume, Windows touch button, barcode/camera touch button, programmable touch button
specs.storage: 256 GB M.2 GB SATA SSD (512 GB optional)

unconfirmed.certification.northAmerica: From the maker's published information; we haven't seen the North American certificate.
unconfirmed.certification.division: From the maker's published information; we haven't seen the North American certificate.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Microsoft ended Windows 10 Pro support on 14 October 2025. The maker doesn't state the edition; an LTSC edition would run longer.
unconfirmed.removable: Not stated by the maker for this exact model.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
limitations: Discontinued; the ecom Pad-Ex 01 P12 DZ2 replaces it
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
